Such notice mailed by the department of finance pursuant to this section shall have stamped or printed thereon a reference to section 28-204.6.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
